title: Ask on Qwen3.8 27B keeps a drawing its look names correctly, even by a narrower or broader name
goal: Since Qwen3.8 27B became Ask's default, Ask sometimes throws away a good drawing and says it could not make one, because the model that checks the drawing named it more precisely (a blue tit for a bird) or more broadly (a bird for a songbird) and Ask took that as a miss. A drawing whose look names the right kind of thing should be kept.
notes: Trace of scene-bird-singing-on-a-branch, run 20261024-131153-ask (.ask-eval/runs/.../ask-walk/log.json): '137.4s look: a bird on a branch singing seen as blue tit -> does not read', then the model reworded the subject to 'a small songbird ...', '224.8s ... seen as hummingbird -> does not read', reworded again to 'a plump round songbird ...', '280.0s ... seen as bird -> does not read', then Ask said it could not. AskDrawingCheck.reads (AskPlanning.swift ~1151) finds no shared word, so judgeBody asks the planning model 'is what they named the main thing asked for, or a kind of it?'; Qwen3.8 answers no for a narrower species and for a broader 'bird' against 'songbird' (bird is not a kind of songbird). Ideas: judge against the request's own subject rather than the reworded one, and ask whether it is the same kind of thing named more or less precisely; or have reads() count a shared stem inside a compound ('songbird' contains 'bird'). Held-out drawing group also lower on Qwen3.8 (64.4 against 68.4) and layout (12.3 against 22.4; that group is task ask-on-the-local-model-makes-results-that-look-f's bar).
acceptance: The climb cases scene-bird-singing-on-a-branch and style-layered-sunset no longer end in 'I couldn't make a clear drawing of that' on Qwen3.8 27B (both scored 0 in run 20261024-131153-ask; Qwen3.6 35B scored 91.2 and 85.6 on them in 20261024-151759-ask)
The climb set's drawing group on Qwen3.8 27B is at least 85 (79.4 on 2026-10-24, against 86.3 on Qwen3.6 35B), and the held-out drawing group is reported beside it (64.4 against 68.4)
The fix is general (how the look's name is judged against what was asked), tested in PhotonzCore, with no subject or eval case named in code
